gettingStarted.overview: FluentValidation integration for Tempo.Blazor component library. Provides FluentValidationValidator component for EditForm and assembly scanning for validator registration.

items.description: Extension methods for EditContext to enable FluentValidation without using the FluentValidationValidator component. Useful for programmatic validation scenarios.

members.name: AddFluentValidation
members.description: Enables FluentValidation for the EditContext. Attaches OnValidationRequested and OnFieldChanged handlers that resolve and invoke the appropriate IValidator from DI.

items.description: How field-changed events trigger validation in the FluentValidation integration: validate the changed member, the full model, or nothing until submit.

Programmatic options: model provider, rule sets, validation-context preparation, failure-to-field mapping, message formatting, field-changed behaviour and opt-in clearing of external failures on edit.

members.name: ModelProvider
members.description: Supplies the model to validate. Defaults to the EditContext's own model. Returning null skips the run (local messages are cleared) - useful while a page's data has not loaded yet.

members.name: RuleSets
members.description: The rule sets included in a full-model run (composed with the member filter on a member-scoped run). Evaluated per run, so the selection may depend on mutable page state. Null/empty = default rules.

members.name: PrepareContext
members.description: Called with the FluentValidation context before each run - the hook for IValidationContext.RootContextData (e.g. a workflow/validation context object).

members.name: FieldMapper
members.description: Maps a failure to the FieldIdentifier whose message store entry it becomes. Defaults to editContext.Field(failure.PropertyName); returning null falls back to that default. Use to strip collection paths (Items[3].Name -> Name) or otherwise re-key failures.

members.name: MessageFormatter
members.description: Renders the message text stored (and displayed) for a failure. Defaults to ValidationFailure.ErrorMessage. Use to resolve resource keys to localized text.

members.name: ClearExternalFailureOnFieldChange
members.description: Opt-in (default false). When true, editing a field drops the external failures injected via FluentValidationSubscription.SetExternalFailures (e.g. a server 422) that landed on that field, compared on the mapped FieldIdentifier rather than the bare property name; failures on other fields are kept. The clear runs before the local re-validation, and a later SetExternalFailures brings the failure back.

items.description: Disposable subscription returned by the FluentValidation integration's subscription API; detaches the validator's edit-context handlers when disposed.

members.name: Clear
members.description: Clears both layers and notifies the EditContext.

members.name: Dispose
members.description: Unsubscribes from the EditContext and clears all messages this subscription owns.

members.name: SetExternalFailures
members.description: Replaces the external failure layer (server-side / out-of-band failures) and re-renders the store. Null or empty clears the layer. Local messages are untouched. The failures persist until replaced or cleared, or — with ClearExternalFailureOnFieldChange — until their field is edited.

items.description: A Blazor component that integrates FluentValidation with EditForm. Place inside an EditForm to enable FluentValidation-based validation. Works as a drop-in replacement for DataAnnotationsValidator.

members.name: Dispose
members.description: Unsubscribes from EditContext validation events and releases resources.

members.name: Subscription
members.description: The options-driven subscription handle; null unless Options was supplied.

items.description: Extension methods for IServiceCollection to register FluentValidation validators via assembly scanning.

Adapts a FluentValidation IValidator<T> to data-import row validation: each DataImportRow is bound to the model and validated; every failure becomes a DataImportRowError carrying the source row number and the target field key (default mapping lower-cases the first letter of the property name, overridable). Binder exceptions become whole-row errors instead of crashing the batch.

FluentValidation-based IKycStepValidator for TmKycWizard. Each wizard step has its own rule set (person/company identity, documents with expiry, addresses, recursive ownership shares, declarations); failures carry indexed field paths and localization keys instead of display text. The optional constructor delegate supplies the reference date for expiry/birth-date rules.
